meaning: The Milky Way's bulge in old stars: the RR Lyrae stars within 3 kpc of the Galactic centre from OGLE-IV (Prudil et al. 2025), and beyond it Gaia DR3's (Li et al. 2023), thinned outward on the disc's scale length, each at its measured distance: the galaxy's height above the thin disc its arm tracers draw, fading into the disc.

banks.basis: Presentation choices, not paper values: stars within 3 kpc of the Galactic centre show the bulge and leave out the disc and halo stars along OGLE's sightlines, which Gaia's sample draws beyond it; one star in 8, in catalogue order, so the bulge reads as the densest part of the galaxy, as it is.
Presentation choice: one in 8, the share of the OGLE stars inside 3 kpc, so the bulge's density runs on across the two samples.
